title: A person's real decisions
description: examples/decisions.json in a pack: real decisions with their rationale, captured in the decision-capture stage of the interview. A few of the most similar ones are retrieved into a task (examples.py); they move an agent toward a person more than prose directives do.

source.description: The question whose answer recorded it (`Q41`), or an evidence row for a simulated pack (`E3`).

domain.description: The directive domain it bears on (`code_review`).

cues.description: What the person noticed that made the difference.

noviceWould.description: What the person said a less experienced practitioner would have done.

when.description: When it happened, as precisely as the person said (`2026-08`).
